acceptance: A gateway-routed run computes no internal cost total and logs no dollar figure
A test runs the cost path with gateway_routed true and resource_usage present and asserts no total is produced
context: Found by an independent review of the site page docs/platforms/snowflake-gateways.md against core v0.5.1 (91d357a); each claim was re-verified by a second reviewer.
description: core/cost/integration.py:81 gates per-query cost on gateway_routed, but _collect_query_costs_from_executions (integration.py:707-724) is not gated. Snowflake attaches resource_usage to every query, gateway or not (platforms/snowflake.py:1519-1523), and the power phase passes it into the ungated path (integration.py:738). So for a gateway run the internal benchmark_cost.total_cost and the log line 'Cost estimation complete: $...' (integration.py:121) show a dollar figure, while the written result suppresses it (results/schema.py:781). The log contradicts the documented rule that a gateway run has no cost total.
